definitions.explanation: The quality or degree to which a substance is poisonous or harmful to living organisms.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{毒性|どくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{毒性|どくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{化学物質|かがくぶっしつ}→化学物質：19856_kagakubusshitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Highly toxic chemicals are strictly controlled.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧キノコ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{毒性|どくせい}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to investigate the toxicity of this mushroom in detail.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧ (poison) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature/property). Refers to the inherent toxic quality of a substance rather than the poison itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毒性|どくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — to be toxic
- {毒性|どくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ — highly toxic
- {毒性|どくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ — mildly toxic
- {毒性|どくせい}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ — toxicity test
- {毒性|どくせい}⟦{物質|ぶっしつ}→物質：03608_busshitsu⟧ — toxic substance
- ⟦{急性|きゅうせい}→急性：09015_kyuusei⟧{毒性|どくせい} — acute toxicity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有毒|ゆうどく}→有毒：23801_yuudoku⟧ — poisonous, toxic (adjective-like; describes that something has poison)
- ⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧ — poison (the substance itself)
- ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧ — harmful (broader; includes things that aren't specifically poisonous)
- ⟦{危険性|きけんせい}→危険性：17827_kikensei⟧ — dangerousness (broader concept of risk)
